race.comment: OLE STEELE (2) led from barrier rise and completely dominated first-up over this distance at Newcastle. Lightly raced filly who looks like living up to her promise this prep. Should ping straight to the lead and prove tough to run down again. BIG BRAD (4) comes back sharply in distance after racing handy and just missing last time out over 1300m at Armidale. Should enjoy a soft run back on the fence and will be putting in the big ones late. FLYING LOW (6) did some early work to find the lead then dug deep to record a courageous win on debut recently over 1000m at Muswellbrook. Capable of another bold display from the good gate. BLIND SQUIRREL (5) disappointed over 1000m at Port Macquarie last start after two nice efforts over today's trip to kick off the campaign. Worth another chance. MARKWELL TOPSORT (3) caught the eye at Port Macquarie last time out. Suited by the small field so not out of calculations.
